notes.content:
Thanks to suggestions from my wonderful players I improved several things:
 [list]
[*]Fixed some typos.
[*] Removed the items causing problems after traversing to the last scene (items that were actually only confusing players at this stage). 
[*]Added a short conversations about the key and cross in the church.
[*]Added an immediate traversal to the hut after dealing with the "obstacle" - this should save some unnecessary walking.
[*]Replaced some dialogue with a better suited one (map interactions  while dealing with the "obstacle" e.g.).
[*] Trying to feed various animals will now have the appropriate response.
[/list]
